verdict.rationale: QBO ships built-in rule-based automation for specific accounting events—bank transaction rules (confirmed by a community user: 'I already have automatic rules build right into QuickBooks Online'), automated payment/late-payment reminders, and (in Advanced) custom workflows/fields—so some event-triggered automation exists. However, this is a fixed set of accounting-specific triggers/actions, not a general-purpose rule engine where an AI-native user can define arbitrary event→action logic across the platform. Missing for 10: a documented general workflow/rules builder for arbitrary events and actions, API/webhook-driven custom trigger definitions, and independent verification beyond one community mention.
